title: The Cars That Made America
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
Young visionaries wage battle for control of the fledgling industry; Henry Ford, William Durant, Walter Chrysler and the Dodge brothers revolutionize transportation, while paving the way for the largest and most influential corporate empires.

title: The Cars That Made America
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
The automobile begins to transform the United States; cities and towns change to suit the automobile; the middle class grows due to the booming manufacturing sector; the Big Three dominates the industry while the battle to be number one heats up.

title: The Cars That Made America
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3
After World War II, Americans move to the suburbs, fueling demand for new cars and leading to the golden age of the American automobile; car companies create the muscle car, even as external influences threaten to bring the industry to its knees.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description:
S01 E05 — Mind Games
From the CIA's decades-long pursuit of the perfect truth serum to the U.S. Army's secret PsyOps in Vietnam, mind games have long been at play among countries, its enemies and even its own citizens; every one a more alarming deception than the next.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description:
S01 E03 — Extreme Missions
From the depths submarine divers have plunged to tap a secret Soviet communication line to the Special Ops team of suicidal soldiers sent to hand-deploy A-bombs in enemy territory, when is "Mission: Impossible" more than just a movie?

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description:
S01 E10 — Unholy Alliances
When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head on.

title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
description:
S01 E08 — Deep Space
Glimpses into NASA's covert plan to blow up the moon with a nuclear warhead, the Soviet Union's cover-up of history's deadliest space disaster, and how U.S. attempts to put spies in orbit paved the way for the first space station.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E03 — Mad Medicine
There was a time when any and all cures could be sold to the public indiscriminately; diving into a world where animal skin can replace your own, where doctors give coffee enemas and a world of heroin-laced cough syrup.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E06 — Thrills & Spills
Remember when people would do just about anything for an adrenaline fix?; revisit the ways people once chased a thrill; these stunts and gravity-pushing spectacles didn't always stick the landing, but that didn't stop anyone from trying.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E01 — Perilous Play
Remember when childhood came with a side of danger? Think back to the toys and daredevil playground antics that once defined growing up; uncovering explosive science kits, high-flying kite tubes and more.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S02 E13 — Animal Anarchy

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E02 — Spectacular Stunts
A wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush; from the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons and diving horses, these stunts are as reckless as they are unforgettable.

title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
description:
S01 E06 — Food Fiascos
Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past; from radioactive energy drinks, to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, to the additives in your milk and bread, uncovering the things people once ate without a second thought.

description:

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E01 — Road Warriors
During WWII, a struggling automaker and Detroit's industry titan race to build a revolutionary all-purpose military vehicle, then spend decades battling to reinvent their wartime creation into America's popular type of car, the SUV.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E02 — The Game Makers
Mark Goodson and Merv Griffin wage a three-decade battle to reinvent the television game show, creating franchises with spinning wheels, buzzers and catchphrases that become ingrained in American culture as billion-dollar global brands.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E04 — Racing to the Top
A down-on-his-luck mechanic transforms outlaw moonshine racing into a major American spectator sport, overcoming rivals, setbacks, and financial crises to build a billion-dollar sports empire.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E06 — Rise of the Personal Computer
A pair of garage tinkerers, a copier company's secret lab, and a college-dropout programmer spark a decades-long battle for the future of computing - shrinking the computer from a room-sized machine to the device billions carry every day.

title: The Mega-Brands That Built America
description:
S04 E03 — Ideas That Stick
A husband's homemade bandage, a college dropout's breakthrough adhesive and a factory worker's wartime fix transform simple strips of tape into indispensable American icons, creating a $90 billion industry, one sticky invention at a time.

title: American Pickers
description:
S18 E03 — 40 Acre Pick
Plowing through a 40-acre salvage yard, Mike and Frank harvest a few lost treasures, including a never-before-seen farmer's mini-bike.

title: American Pickers
description:
S11 E02 — KISS and Sell
A costume shop in upstate New York; a stash of Art Deco cigarette machines; an appraiser is awestruck by a recent find; Mike's coveted 1911 Harley is finally ready for its first test drive.

title: American Pickers
description:
S17 E08 — Queen of Fortune
The picking gets red, hot and blue in a Louisiana warehouse as Mike makes a move on Gypsy Grandma, the queen of arcade games.

title: American Pickers
description:
S07 E09 — Substitute Picker
Mike's brother Robbie fills in for Frank while he is sick; the guys find a barn-sized man-cave filled with an awesome collection; Robbie feels the pressure to out pick Mike.

title: American Pickers
description:
S21 E10 — Pickin' Safari
Teeming with taxidermy, Ron's Illinois home is like "Pet Sematary" meets the Natural History Museum.

title: American Pickers
description:

In the heartland of beer, Frank is surprised to meet an old friend; the guys secretly prepare a surprise build for Danielle.

title: American Pickers
description:

Jackie Hollywood unveils his incredible body shop art gallery; Les and Loretta's sprawling warehouses; Danielle hauls a rare but rusted out Lambretta scooter.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E14 — Rock and a Hard Place
Mike and Frank go behind the scenes of a famous tourist attraction for the pick of a lifetime; in Cape Cod, Mass., a collector shuts down deal after deal until his wife steps in.

title: American Pickers: Best Of
description:

Ride along with the Antique Archaeology team as they discover items so unique it'd be a pickin' crime not to bring back to life.

title: American Pickers
description:

Mike and Frank negotiate with the sibling owners of an antique shop closed since the 1970s; the guys come upon a historic aircraft with an amazing back-story.

title: American Pickers

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E03 — The Dyatlov Pass Incident
An infamous Cold War cold case involving nine hikers found mutilated on a remote mountain slope; for over 60 years, authorities and amateurs alike have been trying to figure out what happened in a place that's been called "Russia's Area 51."

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E09 — Who Killed King Tut?
The death of one of history's most enigmatic rulers, Egypt's King Tutankhamun remains shrouded in mystery 3300 years later. Scientific advancements may be getting us closer to the identity of King Tut's killer.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E01 — The Final Hunt for D.B. Cooper
With over 7,500 hours investigating the mystery; top D.B. Cooper expert Eric Ulis believes that he's found the true location where Cooper landed during his daring dive.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S02 E04 — Houdini's Lost Diaries
Magician and Houdini expert Bill Kalush secures access to Harry Houdini's diary previously kept from the public; experts begin to unveil the diary, using information gleaned from these personal accounts to form new insights into Houdini's life.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E17 — Secrets of the Sphinx
Rising from the sands of the Egyptian desert is one of the ancient world's greatest wonders, the mighty Sphinx.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E12 — The Missing Riches of Genghis Khan
The ancient ruler who amassed a fortune estimated to be worth 120 trillion in today's dollars; Genghis Khan hide his riches so well that to this day no one has unearthed them; 800 years later the fate of his treasure remains a mystery.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E04 — The Body on Somerton Beach
As the Cold War ramps up, a well-dressed man is found dead within miles of a nuclear testing site on a tranquil Australian beach; there are no clues to his identity or what could have happened.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E04 — The Escape of John Wilkes Booth
Booth family members share family lore, and what they believe is evidence of the assassin's escape, passed down through generations.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E09 — The Voynich Manuscript
A medieval manuscript, which is filled with unidentifiable drawings and written in a secret language so complex that even the world's best code breakers can't crack, it has obsessed everyone from scholars to conspiracy theorists.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Hunt for Stolen Nazi Treasure: WWII Edition
During World War Two, the Nazis stole vast amounts of art, gold, silver and currency, and stashed it across Europe; while some of the plunder has been recovered, much more is still missing nearly 80 years later.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Lost Gold of WWII: WWII Edition
During World War II, Japan plunders a fortune worth hundreds of billions of dollars from occupied countries, but to this day its whereabouts are unknown.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E13 — The Lufthansa Heist
On December 11, 1978, a gang of thieves lifted around $5 million in cash and $800,000 in jewelry from a luxury airline hangar at New York's JFK Airport, marking the largest heist in U.S. history at that time.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

She was the last pharaoh of Egypt and one of the most famous queens of all time, but her death in 31 B.C. has been shrouded in mystery; Cleopatra's body and final resting place have been lost without a trace for over 2,000 years.
